ray_geometry_policy.included: all URDF collision primitives/STL meshes plus STL visual meshes
ray_geometry_policy.collada_visual_policy: DAE visual surfaces are not triangulated; every physical DAE link is represented by its URDF collision mesh or primitive
ray_geometry_policy.sensor_self_link_policy: only the emitting sensor housing link is ignored; physical brackets remain occluders

scan_domains.cameras: rectilinear or equiangular fisheye grid over frozen contract FOV
scan_domains.gnss: uniform-solid-angle sky above the declared 15deg satellite elevation mask

claim_boundary: Deterministic mesh-ray self-occlusion, mount/FOV parameter and declared work-zone audit against the expanded URDF. It does not replace Gazebo rendered/range-message visibility, lens distortion calibration, satellite multipath modelling or real installation calibration.
